newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-FEMALE FANS CHASE TOMBA ON INTERNET.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-FEMALE FANS CHASE TOMBA ON INTERNET.

text.p: Italian skiing hero Alberto Tomba is being propositioned by his lovelorn female fans on the Internet.

Tomba told a news conference after finishing second in a World Cup slalom at Madonna di Campiglio on Tuesday -- his first race of the season after recovering from injury -- that he had received various messages from admirers.
He said one woman had told him how good he looked with his new curly hairstyle and wanted to meet him.
"I told her 'You've seen my photo on the Internet. Now I want to see yours'," said Tomba.

The daily Corriere dello Sport reported that the Italian triple Olympic gold medallist was being bombarded with love messages as well as highly technical questions from fans through his new web address.
"Many of the requests are hot, to say the least," one of his public relations staff was quoted as saying.
